english.title: Fail to stop / permit inspection of a vehicle / package brought into a Mersey tunnel / approach / marshalling area
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to allow

(A)_[a Mersey Tunnels police officer]_
(B)_[an authorised officer]_

to stop and inspect a

(C)_[vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[package]_

brought

(E)_[into the tunnels]_
(F)_[onto the tunnels' approaches or marshalling areas]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL / APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..), the officer having reason to suspect that it contains

(G)_[a matter or substance prohibited from the tunnels or their approaches by Byelaws 3(p)]_
(H)_[goods referred to in Byelaw 7(c) the necessary permission for the entry of which has not been granted]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(a) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to allow a Mersey Tunnels police officer / other authorised officer
to stop and inspect a vehicle / package
brought into the tunnels / onto the tunnel approaches / marshalling areas
the officer having reason to suspect that it contains
a matter / substance prohibited from the tunnels / their approaches by Byelaws 3(p) OR
goods referred to in Byelaw 7(c) the necessary permission for the entry of which had not been granted

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
